note: USACE Louisville District campground on a wooded ridge above Green River Lake near Campbellsville; the lake is not visible from the sites. Mostly long back-in sites; playground and hiking trail. Now run by volunteers with limited tollhouse hours; marina swim beach and disc golf within about a mile. Weak cell signal. --Claude
summary: Corps campground, rec.gov 233633 active, 80 sites (61-62 W/E 50A), $20/$26/$32, peak season only (2027: May 14-Sep 11), reserve first (no walk-up setup), 14-night limit. Not waterfront confirmed: no cell at summer pool within the 400 m DEM box; nearest low ground is above-pool bottomland 13+ m below the pads. Old note's 'along the lake perimeter with many waterfront-access sites' was wrong and is replaced.
flags: WATERFRONT: stays not waterfront. 3DEP: west-ridge pads 249-254 m, east-loop pads 221-230 m; Green River Lake summer pool 205.7 m and no cell at or below it within 400 m of the centroid 37.2943,-85.2940 (box minimum 206.4 m). The nearest low ground (207-209 m, a bottomland field on imagery) is 52 m+ from sites 50/51 and 13+ m below them - fails the kayak test even if it flooded. The previous note's 'set along the lake perimeter with many waterfront-access sites' is contradicted and removed.

OPERATIONS: rec.gov notice 'Campground now ran by volunteers. There will be limited tollhouse hours and services offered.' and 'Do not set up at any campsite without reserving the site first' - put in the note; fcfs never.
SEASON: peak-only rate table (2026 05-08..09-12; 2027 05-14..09-11); unstaffed 09/14/2026-05/13/2027. Written as the 2027 dates.
SITE 'Max Vehicle Length' 20 ft on one electric site with an 81-ft driveway (catalog oddity); every other site 43-84 ft. Fits a 23-ft rig.

PIN 37.2944,-85.2921 is ~170 m east of the site centroid (inside the east loop's edge). No move. PHONE 270-789-2743 (staffed season) matches rec.gov; off-season general line (270) 465-4463 - not written. WEBSITE recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/233633 unchanged.
